description: A React component for browsing and managing channels in the Mattermost application, including searching, filtering, and creating channels.

classes.name: BrowseChannels
classes.description: React component class for browsing channels with search, filter, and modal functionalities.

methods.name: loadComplete
methods.description: Sets loading state to false after initial data fetch.

methods.name: handleNewChannel
methods.description: Opens modal to create a new channel.

methods.name: closeEditRHS
methods.description: Closes the right-hand side panel if in edit history state.

methods.name: onChange
methods.description: Resets search results and errors, optionally forcing update.

methods.name: nextPage
methods.description: Loads the next page of channels.

methods.name: handleJoin
methods.description: Handles joining a channel and navigation.

methods.name: setSearchResults
methods.description: Filters and sets search results based on current filters and membership.

methods.name: changeFilter
methods.description: Changes the channel filter and updates search results.

methods.name: isMemberOfChannel
methods.description: Checks if the current user is a member of a given channel.

methods.name: handleShowJoinedChannelsPreference
methods.description: Toggles display of joined channels and updates local storage.

methods.name: getChannelsWithoutJoined
methods.description: Filters out channels the user has already joined.

methods.name: getActiveChannels
methods.description: Returns the list of channels to display based on filters and search.
